probes.title: Information without generic Productness
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Semantic coherence and an Information Proposition alone do not establish BPS Productness.

probes.title: Rich Data versus Information
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: A qualified enriched Data Product may have Information semantics while its intrinsically constituted Family remains disputed.

probes.title: General analytic capability versus promised Information
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: A tool or computation service does not inherit Information Product Family from its outputs.

probes.title: Static and human Information formation
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Absence of continuous/owned analytics engines does not independently disqualify a static or editorial Information candidate.

probes.title: AI participation and changed Product Promise
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: AI dependencies do not automatically confer AI Family; materially changed Promise requires independent assessment.

probes.title: Multi-promise and Compound ambiguity
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Aggregated propositions do not establish one Information Product or independently approved BPS Compound status.

probes.title: Correct definition with incorrect execution
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Correctly declared VWAP with arithmetic-mean realization violates fidelity despite successful deployment.

probes.title: Different golden paths, common governing Promise
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Different realizations do not automatically change Family or prove semantic equivalence.

probes.title: Versions, parameters, instances and occurrences
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Occurrence/parameter change does not automatically create Product identity or Family change.

probes.title: Valid signature and disputed substantive passport claim
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: DPP authenticity/integrity can coexist with unsupported or false fidelity claims.

probes.title: Maturity-like characteristics without qualification
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: High score/registry presence cannot establish Productness; no Information PMDD scoring is adopted.

probes.title: Fitness changes with consumer purpose
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Same Product/Information may be fit for education but not real-time trading.

probes.title: Consumption access without consequential authority
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Entitlement to read does not confer permission to decide or trade.

probes.title: Usage and favorable outcomes without demonstrated value
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Consumption/association do not establish causal Value.

probes.title: Historical semantics and evidence uncertainty
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Later change cannot rewrite historical decision; inaccessible evidence is not proven conformance or violation.

probes.title: Research coherence without normative source adoption
probes.expectedConditionalInterpretation: Internal coherence does not discharge G03 normative-release holds or certify Product qualification.
